The match pits the league's second-placed side against the fourth-placed team, with both clubs firmly in the hunt for Champions League qualification. Dinamo enter the game on a strong run of form, having won four of their last five league matches, while Krasnodar have collected seven points from their last five outings. With only five points separating the two sides in the table, the result could have a significant impact on the top-four race.

The fixture is part of the 2026-27 Serie A campaign and will be played at the Allianz Stadium, Juventus' home venue since 2011. Juventus enter the match in seventh place with 18 points from 11 matches, while Venezia sit 19th with six points from the same number of games. The hosts are chasing European qualification; the visitors are fighting to avoid an early relegation battle.
